        slugs:

fix(web-ui): address fix cycle 1 feedback for dashboard overview

Two issues resolved:

1. Blocked count card semantics: The status summary "Blocked" card previously
   counted pending tasks with unmet dependencies as "blocked", but the card
   linked to /tasks?status=blocked which only shows tasks with actual
   status=blocked. Now the blocked card only counts status=blocked tasks,
   making the count match the click-through results. Pending tasks with
   unmet deps are not counted in any status card — they resolve naturally
   when predecessor tasks complete.

2. AC validation gap in E2E tests: Tests previously only verified structure
   and navigation due to the hardcoded DAEMON_API_BASE port mismatch with
   ephemeral E2E ports. Now tests use page.route() to intercept browser-side
   API calls and fulfill with fixture-consistent data, validating the full
   UI aggregation path (fetch → compute → render). New tests verify:
   - Correct aggregated counts per status from task data
   - Needs-attention counts from inbox, observations, validation, blocked
   - Empty state when all attention counts are zero
   - Active fleet rendering when agents are running
   - Attention card link destinations

Task: @implement-dashboard-overview
Spec: @ui-dashboard-overview

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
